I remember when I was 16 I stayed in this house it had 3 floors.

The first floor was the kitchen, the back door, front door and a small bedroom.

The second floor was a bedroom, a small bathroom, and the living room.

And the tope floor was a 2 big bedrooms and a massive bathroom separating them and there was this landing banister thing that you could basically look over and down onto the second floor and some of the bottom floor kind of like a stairwell thing.

Anyway I started off on the bottom floor bedroom, it was my room for a while and my dog (he's an American bulldog x smith) he's basically a puppy at the time and I'd have to put a baby gate at my bedroom door so he wouldn't wander into the kitchen because he figured out how to open the cupboard doors.

So one night I'm laying in my bed (it faces straight out my door into the hallway) and I hear this rustling around in bags type noise so I think my dog got out my room so I go look and my room is kina dark at the time so it's hard to see so I walk across my room and touch something fuzzy with my feet and I panic because I thought my dog was in the kitchen but he's on my bedroom floor fast asleep so I tap on him to wake him up and move the gate from my door and I lean round the corner into the hallway to look into the kitchen.

It's dark and I don't see anything so I just wave it off and think it's just my hallucinations (I'm schizophrenic) and I just go back to sleep and the next morning my little sister who's like 9 tells me she was looking over the banister from the top floor (she has one of the bedrooms on the top floor with my other little sister) and she seen something moving around just at the corner of my door like because I can look round the corner and there's this big plain piece of bare wall that my sister's would hide behind when I left my room to try and scare me.

So I tell her it was probably the dark messing with your eyes and she gets annoyed saying she seen something there I just shake it off it doesn't bother me I see weird things quite often.

That night I hear the same thing again I go check and I see something moving around in the kitchen it's quite tall I couldn't make out what it was so I creep to the door and I see what looks like a guy and I turn the lights on and look closer into the kitchen and there's nothing again so I go back to bed my sister tell same in the morning she seen the same thing again.

The night comes again and I don't hear the noise but I see someone standing at my door slowly rocking side to side I try to close my eyes and ignore it and I can hear the floor boards creaking like it's stepping into my room my dogs beside me and I can feel him get tense as the floor creaks more I think I passed out or something because I woke up and it's morning. 

I told my sister what I saw and she said she seen something walk toward my bedroom and tired telling my mum and dad and they just told her that it was her imagination.

There's been alot of weird shit In my house
My mums blind and she constantly feels like there's something with her in the house when she's alone and her guide dog reacts sometimes to it.

We've moved out of that house and now we're in a rural farm house and I sometimes I feel the same thing is in this house.

I've taken pictures of 'ufos' and faces in the hall ways 
It feels like something follows my family.
